summary: Full end-to-end coverage of Client CAS Invite flow (MFD auth routes + public client-facing routes + public wizard UI). Backend pytest: 15/15 passed. Frontend: MFD modal + public /cas-connect/:token wizard both behave correctly, including anonymous access and bad-token error state.
critical_code_review_comments: Public invite URL is built off request.headers.origin with a fallback to referer+base_url. Works in-browser but a pure curl (no Origin header) falls back to cluster-internal base_url — not a bug for real users, but worth keeping in mind.
oauth_tokens are correctly excluded from MFD list response via projection {'oauth_tokens': 0}. Confirmed in test.
Revoke clears oauth_tokens to None and sets status=REVOKED — good. Bad-token revoke returns 404 (safe).

_handle_invite_oauth_callback is reachable via both /api/public/cas-invite/oauth/callback (legacy shim) and /api/oauth/gmail/callback (dispatch via state prefix invite_*). Dispatch confirmed at routes/gmail.py line 72-74.
Public GET /{token} soft-expires invite to EXPIRED in DB on read when past expiry — good self-healing behaviour.
404 is returned for non-existent invites AND when revoke is requested on a token that doesn't belong to the profile/user — this prevents enumeration.
Token format is uuid4().hex (128-bit entropy) — acceptable for a 7-day shareable link.
seed_data_creation: Several test invites created under profile AMIT PORWAL during pytest + UI flow. Left in DB for next iteration's context (history card shows them).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 15 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_client_cas_invite.py cover create/list/revoke/unauth/404/410/expired/public-details/gmail-connect-url/scan-guard/status. Uses pymongo directly to simulate expiry (MONGO_URL+DB_NAME env). Frontend: priyanka's Client 360 for AMIT PORWAL → header button data-testid='snapshot-invite-client' → modal data-testid='invite-modal' → data-testid='invite-active' + data-testid='invite-url-input' (must start with window.location.origin /cas-connect/<token>). Public page /cas-connect/:token renders without a session cookie; header data-testid='cas-connect-header'; Google sign-in button data-testid='cas-google-signin'. Invalid token shows 'Link not available' AlertCircle card. The 401s seen in browser console on the public page are from the global app bootstrap that tries /api/me — harmless; public page is not gated on it. Actual Google OAuth round-trip is intentionally not exercised.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Feature is production-ready for the scope tested.
